title: Cytokine Storm and Organ Damage in Severe Viral Infection
text: Cytokine storms driven by excessive IL-6, TNF-alpha, and IL-1-beta release are implicated in multi-organ damage during severe viral infection. We analysed serum cytokine profiles in 340 hospitalised patients and found that peak IL-6 levels predict ICU admission with high accuracy. Unlike bacterial sepsis, viral cytokine storms show a delayed IL-10 response. Anti-inflammatory strategies targeting the IL-6 receptor reduced mortality in a subset of patients. Further studies are needed to define optimal dosing windows and identify patients most likely to benefit.
